text:
anya: quick q — compliance wants actor_ip + device_fingerprint in NDJSON change exports. allowed? they need to correlate alerts.
chris: do we need raw IP? can we pseudonymize? :thinking_face:
anya: legal wants reversible mapping for investigations. pseudonymize helps but may not be enough.
jordan: reversible mapping = tenant-scoped key store/HSM + access controls. ops surface area increases.
sam: also payload impact — device fingerprints are long base64 strings; repeated fields will bloat exports.
nina: streaming SIEMs complain about line size. let's estimate bytes before making a change.
dev_bot: Export Service notice — default export quota 10GB/day per-tenant. Large exports may receive 429s and async retries.
chris: proposal: add export detail_profile param: minimal | audit | forensic. forensic includes reversible tokens; audit = pseudonymized; minimal = current.
anya: +1. forensic should be enterprise opt-in with ToS acknowledgement.
jordan: API sketch:
```
POST /v1/exports
{
  "scope":"tenant:abc",
  "format":"ndjson",
  "detail_profile":"forensic", // minimal|audit|forensic
  "estimate_only":false
}
```
chris: estimate_only=true returns size_estimate_bytes and quota_cost.
sam: emit telemetry per-export: estimate_bytes, actual_bytes, pct_overrun, reversible_keys_used. ops + billing need this.
nina: add X-Export-Profile header on streaming so consumers know line shape up front.
chris: add redaction params: redact_fields=["user.email","request.headers.authorization"] and redact_mode=hash|remove|tokenize.
legal: reversible keys only for customers opting into forensic; must use KMS envelope keys per-tenant and have explicit audit trail for key unseals.
jordan: another idea: separate PII addendum — main NDJSON stays pseudonymized with event_id + actor_hash; a secure addendum file maps event_id -> (ip, device, raw_actor_id encrypted). reduces SIEM noise.
anya: good separation. require manifest at top of bundle listing addenda, sizes, checksums, and whether addendum is present.
sam: implement dry-run sampling endpoint that samples N events (default 1000) and returns avg_line_bytes to compute estimate.
nina: consumer guidelines: streaming clients should fetch manifest first, then decide whether to download addendum (encrypted) or not.
jordan: ops: if estimate > 2x quota auto-trigger a quota-bump request flow and email tenant admins with signed estimate.
chris: security: reversible mapping access RBAC-gated, unseal events logged to audit index with requester and reason.
anya: QA: include actor_resolution_history in export so actor display/name at event_time is persisted. adds some bytes but essential for "who" questions.
sam: prototype: estimate API + manifest schema. i'll take it.
nina: i'll draft consumer streaming guide.
jordan: legal: i'll draft opt-in checklist and controls.
anya: action items summarized: @sam build estimate API, @anya write proposal & sample NDJSON, @nina consumer guide, @jordan legal checklist. follow-up in #all-hands next week. :thumbsup:
dev_bot: Reminder: schema migration window Thu 2026-03-18 02:00-04:00 UTC — exports may be affected.
